integrity: Analytic proof reconstructed for the nonseparable ℓ-infinity model; supplementary finite checker is reproduced. No independent audit or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Locally finite infinite rooted trees, arbitrary positive edge weights, bounded multipliers on big Lipschitz spaces under two specified norms; not a statement about general infinite graphs. Priority risk from older operator-theory treatments of triangular matrices and incompletely accessible historical sources. Finite tests do not prove infinite conclusions.
title: Exact essential norms of multipliers on big weighted Lipschitz spaces of rooted trees
